testi1_text: J'ai trouvé la seule préparation au JAMB enseignée entièrement en yoruba. Cela a tout changé. J'ai obtenu 312 points et j'ai été admise à l'Université d'Ibadan !
testi2_text: En tant que couturière à Calcutta sans formation officielle, j'ai terminé trois cours de patronage. J'ai maintenant un atelier de 12 personnes et une liste d'attente ! 🧵
testi3_text: J'ai réussi mon Abitur tout en travaillant à temps plein, en utilisant uniquement des vidéos téléchargées hors ligne le week-end. Odyssey fonctionne même en 3G en Bavière. 🎉

about_mission_title: Le savoir doit être sans frontières.
about_mission_body: Odyssey was born from the belief that a student's future should not be limited by geography, language, injury, family income, or access to a famous school. We are building a platform where determined learners can reach excellent teachers, strong exam preparation, and practical skills wherever they begin.
about_v1_body: Chaque cours fonctionne hors ligne. Chaque prix est fixé en devise locale. Nous compressons les vidéos pour les réseaux 3G car l'éducation ne peut pas attendre une connexion rapide.
about_v2_body: 70 % de partage des revenus. Pas de suppressions arbitraires. Les instructeurs possèdent leur contenu et construisent de vraies entreprises sur Odyssey.
about_v3_body: Nous recrutons activement des instructeurs qui enseignent dans des langues locales — yoruba, farsi, swahili, tagalog. Un apprenant apprend mieux dans la langue dans laquelle il pense.

about_odyssey_was_built_on_one_belief_th: Odyssey was built on one belief: that where you're born shouldn't determine what you get to learn. We're on a mission to make world-class education radically accessible — for everyone, everywhere.
about_knowledge_should_be_everyone_s_bir: Le savoir devrait être un droit pour tous
about_in_2021_our_founders_noticed_somet: In 2021, our founders noticed something troubling: a Étudiant in rural Nigeria had no access to quality JEE prep, while a Étudiant in a tailoring workshop in Kolkata had no structured path to grow their craft. Both had the talent. Neither had the tools.
about_so_we_built_odyssey_a_platform_whe: So we built Odyssey — a platform where any Enseignant, from any corner of the world, can teach anything; and any Étudiant, regardless of location or income, can learn it. In their own language. At their own pace. Even on a slow connection.
about_today_we_re_12_million_students_st: Today we're 12 million étudiants strong, spanning 190 countries. But we're just getting started. 🚀

about_a_remote_first_team_spread_across_: A remote-prénom team spread across 12 countries — united by a love of learning.
about_adaeze_and_rishi_meet_at_a_ed_tech: Adaeze and Rishi meet at a ed-tech conference in Nairobi and sketch the first version of Odyssey on a napkin. The pitch: a truly global learning marketplace with no compromises on accessibility.
about_we_launch_in_nigeria_india_and_the: We launch in Nigeria, India, and the UK with 12 instructors and 400 étudiants. The offline-first mobile app and local-language support immediately resonate with users.
about_we_raise_18m_expand_to_40_countrie: We raise $18M, expand to 40 countries, and hit 500K étudiants. The vocational catalogue — cookery, tailoring, agriculture — becomes our fastest-growing category.
about_odyssey_becomes_the_largest_global: Odyssey becomes the largest global exam-prep platform by Étudiant count, surpassing 840,000 cours. Our Arabic, Hindi, and Swahili catalogues each surpass 50,000 cours.
about_we_re_building_ai_powered_personal: We're building AI-powered personalised learning paths, expanding live class infrastructure to 80 more countries, and launching the Odyssey Scholarship Fund for étudiants in underserved regions.

earnings_subscription_body_html: Odyssey subscriptions are separate from course sale revenue. The Free plan lets instructors keep up to 5 active courses and 20 exams published. Pro is $15/month for solo instructors, with up to 25 active courses, 100 exams, richer student analytics, CSV exports, and priority review signals. Institutional is $40/month for schools and academies, with up to 100 active courses, unlimited exams, team workspace tools, certificate branding, and institution-level analytics.
earnings_subscription_note: Subscriptions do not reduce your 70% instructor revenue share on course sales. They unlock publishing capacity, analytics, and operating tools for larger teaching businesses.
terms_subscription_body_html: Instructor and institution subscriptions control publishing capacity and dashboard features. The Free plan includes up to 5 active courses and 20 published exams. The Pro plan costs $15/month and includes up to 25 active courses, 100 exams, advanced analytics, and exports for solo instructors. The Institutional plan costs $40/month and includes up to 100 active courses, unlimited exams, team workspace tools, certificate branding, and institution-level analytics.
terms_subscription_note: Subscription fees are billed separately from student course payments. If an account exceeds its plan limit, Odyssey may pause additional publishing until the account upgrades, archives courses, or reduces active exams. You may cancel or change plans according to the subscription settings available in your dashboard.
